entry.title: CWIP Settlement against Final Asset created previous financial year
entry.content:
We have a list of Main Asset Created in previous financial year, however, while settling CWIP asset, the system is conisidering Asset Value date instead of Ordinary Depreciation Date which is fallen last financial year, to calculate depreciation.

Therefore, there is a mismatch of the amount of Depreciation posted in the system.

We are now looking for a solution considering this scenarios. below are the details contain the actual business scenarios:

  1. Asset Acquisition Date: 24-Feb-2026
  2. Ordinary Depreciation Start Date: 24-Feb-2026
  3. CWIP settlement / Asset Value Date: 30-Sep-2026
  4. Current result: depreciation effectively starts from 30-Sep-2026, resulting in only 1 day depreciation through period 06/2026.
  5. Expected business result: the February 2026 depreciation commencement should be respected when the CWIP amount is settled in September 2026.

entry.title: Contract Tax code is preferred before the standard condition record during the PO creation
entry.content: Contract Tax code is preferred before the standard condition record during the PO creation. When a POis created through ME59N or through ME21N tax code should be picked up from the contract.

entry.title: Clarification Required – DMEE Parent Tree Update Popup After S/4HANA Upgrade
entry.content:
Hi Team,

Following the recent system upgrade, I am receiving the below popup whenever I try to make changes to an existing DMEE structure in S/4HANA:

"The parent tree definition was updated. Do you want to apply the changes to your tree now?"

Could you please clarify the purpose of this message and advise on the following?

1. What does this parent tree definition update refer to?
2. Is it possible to make changes to the existing DMEE structure without accepting this synchronization?
3. What changes will be applied to the existing DMEE tree if I accept the popup? Will it impact any of the existing configurations or customizations?
4. Is accepting this update mandatory, or can we continue working with the existing tree definition?

Your clarification would help us understand the potential impact before proceeding with any changes to the existing DMEE structures.

Thanks,

Anji.
